source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Although this is very cool, I found several bugs.

Two mornings ago, I tried minting 7 times while my wallet held ETH but no USDC. The attempts seemed to fail, yet <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example> reports that I have minted 8 times.

With the referral field left blank, I am unsure what should have happened to the commission and ticket for mint 8, since they are meant to go to a previously minted NFT owner. This is a recurring edge case I had not considered. The commission and ticket from mint 9 should have been allocated to mint 8, though perhaps that did not happen because the mint itself failed.

There is also a display problem when I open an NFT from the dashboard: the book cover is oversized and cropped on all sides. Possibly because the mint did not complete, I also cannot work out how to view the actual book.

Tomorrow morning, I’ll try another mint using USDC and see what happens.

source_message.text: Only finalized transactions will now be registered by the system. Among the completed fixes was the correction of the main issue: failed mints caused by paying with ETH rather than USDC had still been recorded in the database.

source_message.text:
Although most of the tweaks look great, minting still fails. The dashboard also continues to show 9 NFTs, and when I click 'open' on those false NFTs, the page leads nowhere.

During a mint attempt, there is no option to select ETH/USDC plus alternatives. My wallet has ETH and USDC enabled, but the third mint still does not work.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:

The NFT certificate works, the mint was counted, and the pool contribution was made, but I still can’t locate the NFT in either my wallet or our dashboard.
Transaction - 0x91e6c3a742bd508f6d19e84c27a5b063f8d2147c

execution.observed_behavior: A completed USDC mint was counted, but the resulting NFT could not be found on the dashboard.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:

\- contract: 0x91e6c3a742bd508f6d19e84c27a5b063f8d2147c

Because the backend already has tokenId 8 in the DB, refreshing the dashboard should render its new metadata and image, along with the PDF link.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
During approval of the USDC spend—not during minting—the 'successful mint' popup appeared and showed mint number 11. In this case, I had used referral code 17; the screenshot shows this with the wallet popup visible.

I cancelled that purchase, then checked and found that I had no NFT. Afterward, I minted using referral code 29. There was no USDC approval signature this time: it went directly to minting and worked perfectly, the popup appeared, and the NFT is visible on the dashboard.

The book decrypted successfully after I signed a transaction, but I'm now stuck on the cover page.

execution.observed_behavior: A completed USDC mint produced an NFT that was visible on the dashboard.
